topic: How does the 11.6% bandwidth of the CTS antenna influence frequency planning and spectral efficiency for broadband satellite links?
consensus_response: The 11.6% bandwidth of the CTS antenna constrains frequency planning, leading to reduced spectral efficiency due to increased inter-beam interference. Advanced techniques like adaptive resource management, precoding, and beamforming mitigate these effects, optimizing signal directionality and minimizing interference.
reference_context: SatCom systems face challenges with limited bandwidth, requiring efficient channel allocation and beamforming strategies.
